methodology.comparison: same sealed Metal-capable executable, explicit CPU versus forced Metal
methodology.warmup: one complete verified Groth16 proof per mode excluded from measured summaries
methodology.process_state: fresh supervised pool per trial; readiness and execute validation precede proving; no persistent warm-process claim
methodology.order: CPU then Metal warmups, then alternating CPU/Metal measured pairs; no automatic retries or selective exclusions
methodology.cold_start: pool startup measured separately; OS, runtime and helper caches warmed, never flushed; no cold-boot claim
methodology.telemetry: before/after and about every 10 seconds; nonprivileged thermal category, power source, load average, top ps CPU names
methodology.thermal_limit: Foundation nominal may also mean unsupported/unknown; pmset absence of warnings is not temperature measurement
methodology.power_limit: power source and low-power-mode only, no wattage/energy or profitability measurement
methodology.resources: existing admission and worker/helper limits retained; RSS excludes helper/VM and unmeasured Metal driver allocations
methodology.background: existing applications and default VM left running; no compilation or unrelated tests scheduled during measured trials

interpretation.primary_metric: execution_and_segment_ms: witness/execution plus all segment operations and per-request backend initialization; no isolated Metal-kernel timing
interpretation.wrap: identity_and_emulated_wrap_ms combines native identity p254 and the local emulated linux/amd64 helper; not native ARM Groth16
interpretation.wrap_diagnostics: identity_p254_diagnostic_ms and shrink_wrap_diagnostic_ms come from exactly one production stderr line per trial, rounded to 0.1 ms; identity includes helper prestart overhead
interpretation.startup: setup discovery/spawn times the validation worker, which can be retired before proving; actual prove_call includes admission/replacement/IPC; residual is not pure startup
interpretation.verification: worker verification is the final SDK check; external_verifier_ms includes unchanged verifier process startup, positive and three negative checks
interpretation.warmup: first complete CPU and Metal proofs are retained but excluded; each trial uses a fresh pool, with no cold-boot or persistent warmed worker claim
interpretation.statistics: all planned measured trials retained; paired descriptive ratios and per-mode median/range/sample deviation; no outlier removal or causal/significance claim
interpretation.telemetry: nonprivileged coarse thermal/power categories and decaying ps CPU averages; nominal/low-power false can mean unknown; no wattage/energy measurement
